description:
Read a text message's current state by ID.

        Returns the message record, including delivery status, or an error.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: get_sms

agent_id.description: The agent this text belongs to: the number's text agent on inbound texts, the agent that wrote it on outbound texts. Null when no agent is involved.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

direction.description: 'outbound' for messages Hail sent, 'inbound' for messages received.
direction.title: Direction

error_code.description: Carrier error code if delivery failed. Null on success or while pending.
error_code.title: Error Code

organization_id.description: Organization that sent or received this message.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

provider_message_sid.description: The carrier/provider's identifier for this message, if assigned.
provider_message_sid.title: Provider Message Sid

requested_at.description: When the send was requested, ISO 8601 timestamp.
requested_at.title: Requested At

segment_count.description: Number of carrier SMS segments the body was split into.
segment_count.title: Segment Count

sent_at.description: When the message was handed to the carrier, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until sent.
sent_at.title: Sent At

title: Get a text message
